notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.8.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] This patch includes a Techtree update with [b]better rewards[/b].
[*] A [b]gamebreaking bug[/b] when reaching higher waves was adressed. If you still encounter this bug please let us now.
[/list]

notes.title: Controller friendliness
notes.content:
[h3]Heres how to use a controller with Zombocalypse:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Use the steam input for controllers and choose the community layout from us.
[*][b]Make sure you enable "auto aim" and "auto fire" in the Options menu[/b]
[*]You can now use the right stick as a mouse for UI selection and the left stick for movement. Change your weapons with the d-pad
[*]Customize the layout for your needs
[/list]

notes.title: Zombocalypse is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for playing Zombocalypse![/b] Now that the game is live, I’d like to share a quick look at what’s coming next.

Our Plans for the Future:

[list]
[*] [b]Launch & Server Stability[/b] – In the first week, we’ll closely monitor game and server performance to ensure a smooth multiplayer experience.
[*] [b]New Features & Improvements[/b] – By the end of the month, expect exciting updates, including new bosses and refinements to existing mechanics. Your feedback is always welcome!
[/list]

For now, enjoy the game—solo or with friends! Stay tuned for our next announcement.
